items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: we were on a program with Soupy Sales before Merv Griffin left Philadelphia... It was his show.

ctx.x: I don’t know. I got it somewhere on tape. “What’s My Line,” and we were on a program with Soupy Sales before Merv Griffin left Philadelphia.
Wow! You were on with Merv Griffin?
